claims.claim: The live OFFLIMITS Men Trail collection contains ONYX in Beige, Black and Transformative Teal.
All three ONYX colourways list a KPU/Flyknit upper, Phylon/TPR sole, moulded-socks insock and lace-up closure.

OFFLIMITS connects the ONYX upper with breathability, flexibility, structure and protection; the sole with cushioning, flexibility, traction and shock absorption; and the insock with a soft, contoured feel.
Sturdy footwear with good traction is appropriate for muddy, potentially slippery trails.
Hiking footwear should fit snugly without feeling tight, leave room for toe movement and be tried with intended hiking socks.

sources.extracted_facts: The live Men's Trail Running Shoes collection displayed ONYX - Beige, ONYX - Black and ONYX - Transformative Teal on 2026-07-22. S.W.A.T. Trail Edition was not present.

Each ONYX colourway lists lace-up closure, KPU/Flyknit upper, moulded-socks insock and Phylon/TPR sole. Product copy links Flyknit and KPU with breathability, flexibility, reinforcement and protection; Phylon/TPR with cushioning, flexibility, traction and shock absorption; and the moulded insock with a soft, contoured feel. The pages position ONYX for trails, hiking, outdoor exploration and training. No waterproof claim appears.
Wet climates can create muddy, slippery trails; NPS recommends sturdy shoes with good traction.
Hiking footwear should fit snugly but not tightly, allow toe movement and be checked with the socks intended for the hike.
The article must use the products from the supplied Men Trail collection and follow OFFLIMITS product-led buying-guide fundamentals.
